Chief Complaint
Follow-up for ulcerative pancolitis.

HPI

Medication List
Mesalamine 2.5g daily.

Gen: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
Vitals: BP 128/78, HR 72 (RRR), Temp 98.6 F, SpO2 97% on RA.
Abd: Soft, non-tender, non-distended. Normal bowel sounds.
CV: RRR, CTAB.
Lungs: Clear to auscultation.
Ext: WNL.

Assessment
1. Ulcerative pancolitis, in remission.

Plan
Continue current mesalamine regimen. Pt to continue monitoring for any return of symptoms. F/u in 6 months for routine evaluation.
